## Overview

This directory contains Root Cause Analyses related to security incidents, breaches, authentication failures, and compliance violations that impact enterprise security posture.
page_texts.3:
[rcas/security/README.md#examples-of-security-rcas]

## Examples of Security RCAs

- Data breaches or unauthorized access incidents
- Authentication/authorization system failures
- Compliance violations (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX)
- Security tool misconfigurations
- Insider threat incidents
- Vulnerability exploitation events
- Malware or ransomware attacks
- Phishing and social engineering incidents
- Certificate expiration and PKI failures
- Identity and access management (IAM) failures
